title: Better for Adults than Kids
text: Better for Adults than Kids. These chair covers are made from a heavy duty clear plastic. They needed modification in order to fit over our dining room chair seats.  They work OK, but are not great. They don’t always stay secured with kids wiggling around on them, and need to be reattached. They do provide protection for off-white upholstery, but need a fair amount of attention to keep in place.

product_metadata.title: Zipcase 2 Pack Stain, Water and Kitty Scratch Resistant Dinning Chair Covers/Slipcovers Chair Protector Waterproof PVC 18x17 inches with Adjustable Belt Strap, Set of 2
features: Easy to Clean - Zipcase clear chair slipcover protect your chairs safe from food and drink spills, you can wiped off most spills with a damp sponge and leave no stain.
Heavy-duty Material - The cover is made of durable clear PVC polymer which is wear and scuffing resistant. You can use it for a long period and fold it to storage when not using.
Appropriate Size Fits For most - The cover fits most chairs from about 16.5" to 18" long, it has a buckle for adjustment and you can adjust it to the most suitable position.
Easy to Assemble - just lay the cover over your chair seat and make it neat, then lock the buckle at the back. It is very convenient to put on and off.
